q1_issues.issue: "nine buckets of salt-bloom" is stored as (Measure sk_bloom_1 quantity 9 bucket), but no dimension word is stated in the clause and Measures & units reserves the slot symbol `unspecified` for a scale no word supplies — `quantity` is licensed only as the Degree-family marker ((Degree <N> quantity <marker>)), never as a Measure scale.
"at the new-moon spring tide" is reduced to the bare time symbol `spring_tide`, silently dropping the stated "new-moon" restriction (Core patterns: a stated restriction is never silently dropped).

q2_gaps: ordinal day-of-year dating in a non-Gregorian calendar ("On day 525 of Year 2") — the Time term inventory presumes month-day calendar expressions, so (Day 525) is used outside its defined range

a named natural-cycle time used as a temporal anchor ("at the new-moon spring tide", "at the new moon") — Time terms cover calendar granularities, deictic constants and day-parts, and `During` is restricted to during/while/throughout, so there is no specified encoding for an "at <tide / lunar phase>" anchor (and no guidance on whether it stays a bare constant or becomes an sk_ eventuality like "the storm")
a container-quantity partitive ("nine buckets of salt-bloom") — the measure exclusion under Possessive/genitive NP names it as not-a-genitive but no section says which head carries it
notes: Sentence 1's (Day 525)/(Year 2) are copied onto the lead (13-14) and Mira-harvest (27-28) events, defensible as anaphoric term propagation off "at the new moon", but the party-harvest event (31-36) is left undated and "the next morning" (42) therefore gets only the day-part with no incremented day term — the frame is carried unevenly across the passage. Everything else checks out: the copular time-modifier dual-emit in sentence 1, the singular-collective no-distribution treatment of "the harvest party"/"the Council", the Agent (not Experiencer) subject of entity-object "reported", and "the Council" as a Name-less capitalized common noun.
